ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi VSAN Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vsan" flag in order to retrieve information about virtual storage. Seen used by malware such as DarkSide.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*vsan.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ get.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ list.*")))
